title: Want to give your AI access to generate images from your own PC?
author: anstice
selftext:
I got tired of prompting various AI's like gemini, chatGPT to try to generate assets for my game when they were always generating fixed resolutions, and the workflow to edit the images and then place them in my game that i'm working on was annoying.

My solution? Have my AI use my local comfyUI instance (Using Qwen Image) and having full control on the resolution, so my pixel art can be real pixel art. Yes I'm talking about an MCP server that i coded for this exact use case. I plugged Claude Code to my locally run MCP (github here: [https://github.com/alecc08/comfyui-mcp](https://github.com/alecc08/comfyui-mcp) it's free to use, MIT license)

The result?

Prompt: "Generate a pixel art smiling cat walking along a fence in 1024x512 resolution"

Result: Tool call, generates an image in my comfyUI instance using my model of choice. When generating completes, claude can download the image directly into my project in the right path. I wont go in full detail, my README should be pretty complete.

Anyway thought people here might be interested, im not selling anything, but I thought this was a cool way to be productive :) Feel free to ask questions. Im not a fan of 99% of MCP servers, but this one is useful to me and I'm happy with the result

comments.author: Adventurous-Pool6213
comments.body: I got tired of generating game assets with Gemini/ChatGPT and constantly fighting fixed resolutions, especially for pixel art. I ended up letting the AI talk directly to my local ComfyUI (Qwen Image) through a small MCP server I built and wired into Claude Code, so I can control resolution from the start. Now I can prompt something like “pixel art cat 1024×512” and it generates at the exact size and drops straight into my project folder, no resizing or cleanup. I’m not a fan of most MCP servers, but this one actually improved my workflow; for quick non-local ideation I sometimes use [gentube](http://gentube.app/?_cid=cm) for the same reason, there is less friction, & more building.
